heading.title: The Extinction, Suspension and Revival of Easements

article.title: Extinction of useless easement.
article.content:
42Extinction of useless easement.

Section 42  ·  Chapter V  ·  page 16 of the Act
An easement is extinguished when it becomes incapable of being at any time under any circumstances beneficial to the dominant owner.
